approval.reason: TF-11 freezes zero matches as the codex-multi-agent-run fixture's correct behaviour on this query, and zero matches render zero cards with nothing to wrap in <mark>; the highlight assertion holds only on the fixtures where a match exists

name: nav.targetInView
note: after a deep link (#ev-N) or a strip click the selected card intersects the list viewport and the hash still names it; today the scroll lands near the card, row measurement shifts the offsets, and the scrollspy re-selects whatever is on top

name: invariant.stripMatchesData
note: for each kind chip selected alone: the strip's rendered data-event-count must equal the count of that kind in the source strip data. Catches a strip that filters on anything other than the event's own kind

name: invariant.canvasPinned
note: the strip canvas must stay pinned to its scrollport at 0%, 50% and 100% horizontal scroll. The paint already subtracts scrollLeft, so a canvas that scrolls away offsets everything twice and the drawn region collapses
